prompt:
The image shows a card-style reference bead loop above several labeled option loops. How many option loops match the reference loop up to rotation only, while keeping the bead order around the loop unchanged? Compare the full colored-shape bead order around each loop and return the valid-option count as an integer.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence format: set "evidence" to an array containing one bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] for each valid option image, ordered from left to right and then top to bottom.
Answer requirement: set "answer" to the exact number of valid option loops as an integer.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[574,671,746,825]],"answer":1}
